name: Fairy lights
line: The fairy lights twinkle on, one by one.

name: Hanging lantern
line: The lantern lights up warm and gold.

name: Window lantern
line: A second lantern glows beside the curtain.

name: Purple crystal
line: The purple crystal hums softly.

name: Green crystal
line: The green crystal sparkles.

name: Jar of flowers
line: The flowers in the jar burst into colour.

name: Floor lantern
line: The little floor lantern flickers awake.

name: Little globe
line: Both globes spin and shimmer.

name: Patchwork quilt
line: The patchwork quilt unfolds in every colour.

name: Potion shelves
line: The potion bottles bubble and fizz.

name: Armchair and books
line: The armchair is soft and ready for reading.

name: Dried flowers
line: The hanging flowers and feathers sway.

name: Bookshelf
line: Every book on the shelf turns its page.

name: Round rug
line: The woven rug glows under your feet.

name: Writing desk
line: The quill dips itself into the ink.

name: Purple curtain
line: The curtain ripples in a magic breeze.

name: Glowing vines
line: The vines climb and blossom.

name: Sleeping cat
line: The cat stretches, yawns and purrs.

name: The fireplace
line: Fire roars in the hearth. The room is warm again.

name: Stained-glass window
line: The window floods the room with coloured light.

name: The forest outside
line: The whole forest wakes up and shines.

name: The Great Tree
line: The Great Tree is alive again. You brought the home back with maths.
